dedupe_keys.name: people near transit oecd urban areas

description: The People Near Transit team publishes population-access measures for mass rapid transit in 85 OECD functional urban areas. The public Figshare deposit is CC BY 4.0 and contains a city-level CSV plus zipped grid maps of population within 500, 1,000 and 1,500 metres of stations or stops. These measures can help initialise transit-access or equity scenarios in city and agent-based simulations. A caveat is that walking distance to a station is only one part of access; service frequency, barriers, fares and actual route choice are not measured in the aggregate proximity statistic. The article reports a fixed network and population snapshot, so this is not a current live transit feed. The linked project code sits on a separate GitLab host that returned a server error during this review. I read the own Figshare metadata and file list without downloading the ZIP, recomputing route access or comparing station inventories. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
